text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the north side of Oakmeadow Boulevard, between Stonefield Crescent (west intersection) and Highcastle Road (south intersection). The proposed amendment will adress traffic congestion caused by vehicles parked on both sides of the street. Currently parking is allowed for a three-hour maximum time limit in this section.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the north side of Oakmeadow Boulevard, between Stonefield Crescent (west intersection) and Highcastle Road (south intersection).
